answer: Once per epoch a seat may pay 1 delta to have the zephyr grade one task, and for each pass the zephyr mints that seat one nontransferable pearl. Vote weight is the square of a seat's pearls, so a veteran with 40 pearls weighs 1,600. An operator who spreads the same 40 delta of tasks across 10 clones earns 4 pearls each, only 160 weight in all. For 10 clones to match 10 veterans, each must clear 40 graded epochs of its own, costing 400 delta, and every added clone owes another 40 epochs that it cannot borrow from a sibling.
